title: Settings
markersHint: Mark players with a colored dot: red = passive play, yellow = suspected cheating, purple = hidden expert. The list is strictly local — never uploaded or shared.
dataLanguageHint: Source of localized names for ships, captains, maps, etc. The same language can differ by region (e.g. CN-server simplified uses animal names for IJN ships, ASIA simplified uses original names). Auto-selected on first launch based on your UI language and realm.
closeBehaviorHint: With “Minimize to tray”, the window close button keeps the app running in the tray — double-click the tray icon to bring the window back, and Quit WoWSP in the tray menu exits for real. With “Quit”, it closes the app straight away.
closeRememberHint: The close dialog’s “Remember my choice” checkbox writes this same setting, so you can always change it back here.
themeSchemeHint: Click a row to apply it; the pencil edits any scheme — changes to a builtin are saved as a same-named override, and deleting that override restores the factory look.
shipTypeColorsHint: Customize the color of each ship type in the ship-distribution charts.
themeEditorHint: Tune the seven brand colors and the on-solid content colors per mode; the remaining surface colors derive automatically. Saving applies the scheme immediately.
geolocationHint: Used for solar-based auto theme. Native fix when the shell provides one, otherwise IP — cached for the session.
wallpaperHint: The built-in illustration follows the interface light/dark mode; the pure-color option paints the theme's own base; custom images are kept in the wallpapers folder of the data directory.
fontSizeHint: Applies to all interface text except the title bar and app title.
dpiHint: Auto keeps the interface at its native size. Pick a scale between 100% and 300% in 25% steps — everything scales together, like browser zoom.
dpiResetHint: Overshot it? Press Ctrl+Alt+0 anywhere to reset to Auto instantly.
dpiRiskyWarning: Scaling to {scale}% may exceed this screen and make the interface hard to use.
networkHint: Proxy used for all outbound requests (stats lookups, model pack, updates). System follows your OS proxy settings.
pairingHint: Let the WoWSP app on a phone browse and download this computer's replays — over the local network, or from anywhere through the built-in internet gateway.
pairingPhoneHint: On the phone, open Replays → Get from PC, switch to Internet and enter the code above. On the same Wi-Fi the computer also shows up automatically.
pairingIdleHint: Turn the server on to reveal the pairing code.
pairingMobileHint: Pair this phone with the WoWSP on your computer to browse and download its replays — over the local network or through the internet.
pairingDevicesForgotten: Paired devices forgotten — phones must re-pair
pairingLanOnly: The internet pairing service is unreachable — pairing is limited to the local network for now.
pairingPhoneHintInternet: On the phone, open Replays → Get from PC, switch to Internet and enter the code above — it works from anywhere.
resourceCdnPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the official Wargaming CDN
resourceCdnHint: Mirror base for portraits and other remote resources — the URL path is preserved, and requests still flow through the app's proxy settings.
cacheUpdateBanner: A resource pack update is available — download it below.
cacheMirrorHint: Prefix used for GitHub downloads (resource packs). Leave empty for a direct connection with built-in mirrors as fallback; pick or enter a ghproxy-style prefix when GitHub is unreachable.
cacheAuxGameparamsDesc: Per-ship armor and ballistics data extracted from the game client.
cacheAuxEncyclopediaDesc: Cached encyclopedia payloads per game version, language and realm.
cacheAuxCommunityDesc: Expected-damage tables used by the PR rating.
overlayDesc: Fetches both teams' stats automatically when a battle starts. The switches below control the two overlay windows independently: the transparent window shown while Tab is held, and the stats card shown while aiming at an enemy player.
overlayTableToggle: Show the window while Tab is held
overlayTableToggleDesc: While Tab is held, overlay each player's colored win rate and average damage on the game's score panel.
overlayAimCardToggle: Show the stats card while aiming
overlayAimCardToggleDesc: While aiming at an enemy player in battle, hang their stats card just below the crosshair.
overlayAimCardHang: Aim card distance from the crosshair
overlayAimCardHangDesc: Pixels between the card's top edge and the crosshair center; default 60. The slider covers 60–240 — the box accepts any value from 0 up, as long as the card stays visible.
overlayRosterDisabledByTable: Disabled by the Tab-window switch above: turn it back on to restore roster recognition.
overlayRosterPluginMissing: The in-game plugin is not installed in the active game install.
overlayFullscreenNote: ※ Unavailable in exclusive fullscreen: in that mode GDI screen capture only returns black frames, and the overlay window cannot sit on top of a fullscreen swap chain. Set the game's display mode to borderless or windowed.
overlayDiagBody: The Tab overlay window was shown, but its content repeatedly never reached the screen — this system's transparent-window composition path is broken. The risk flags detected locally are listed below.
overlayDiagMpo: Multi-Plane Overlay disabled (OverlayTestMode = 5) — a common gaming tweak that reroutes DWM composition; try re-enabling MPO.
overlayDiagTransparency: System transparency effects are off (Settings → Personalization → Colors → Transparency effects).
overlayDiagWebview2Missing: No Evergreen WebView2 runtime registered — the app ships none of its own; repair the system runtime.
overlayDiagCloaked: The overlay window reports as DWM-cloaked (the compositor is not displaying it).
overlayDiagDetectFailure: Last roster-detection refusal: {reason} ({age}s ago) — the table falls back to centered geometry while this persists.
overlayCalibrationDesc: Inspect and calibrate the stored Tab-table anchors the overlay places its stat chips by: one card per registered client, each keeping independent PvP / PvE entries (table rectangle, row layout, window parameters); entries not recorded yet can still be pre-drawn on any reference screenshot.
overlayCalibrationEmpty: No calibration data yet — add a client under Game path, or play a battle with the Tab overlay on and it records itself.
telemetryToggleDesc: Anonymous page views and interface language sent to Google Analytics. Turning this off stops sending immediately.
accountHint: The active account drives My Stats and record lookups. Click a card to switch; use Add player to bind a new one.
statsSectionHint: Display preferences for the water-table PR rating on player stat cards and the live roster.

statsPrefs.prToggleDesc: Show the PR rating score and tier on player stat cards. Off by default.
statsPrefs.prAlgoDesc: Which formula computes the PR score.
statsPrefs.teamWrToggleDesc: Weight the live-battle team winrate by ship tier (higher tiers count more); off takes the plain average.
statsPrefs.sealsToggleDesc: Inked 神了/猴/蛆 verdict seals — shown only under a Chinese interface.
statsPrefs.localizedTiersToggleDesc: Fun localized tier wording (夯/人上人/战舰仙人…); off shows the standard English bands Bad/Good/Unicum.
statsPrefs.prTintToggleDesc: Wash each live-roster row with the player's PR-tier color (red band red, purple band purple); on by default.

sealCustomizer.desc: Seals come in two tiers: tier-1 single-character stamps (过街老鼠 included) and tier-2 four-character tags (the composition and merged seals). On the live / post-battle rosters, tier-1 seals press as the square stamp image at each entry's side, tier-2 seals as the small horizontal tag beside the score. Click a seal to set a custom picture for it; a customized seal goes back to its default face with one click (pictures live in the stamps folder of the app data directory). The switch toggles each seal; previews update live.
sealCustomizer.clickEdit: Click to set a custom image
sealCustomizer.clickRemove: Click to remove the custom image and restore the default
sealCustomizer.pickFailed: Failed to import the custom seal image
sealCustomizer.resetFailed: Failed to reset the seal to its default

resourcesGameHint: Caches extracted from the game client, hot-updated ship data, and the Mod Hub index. Clearing a cache is safe — the app rebuilds or re-downloads it when needed.
resourcesBakedHint: Pre-baked 3D models, textures and decision-model data. These are content-addressed downloads or out-of-band packs, never game-client files.
resourcesAiHint: The built-in decision model runs on the CPU. The bundled DirectML runtime only satisfies ONNX Runtime's load-time import; inference never uses the GPU.
resourcesAiAvailable: Included in this build. Inference and scoring run on the CPU.
resourcesAiUnavailable: AI inference and scoring are not included in this build.
resourcesAiUnavailableHint: Install the full version to run inference and scoring.
resourcesDirectMLPresent: Present beside the application ({size}); inference still runs on the CPU.
resourcesDecisionsDesc: Fire model (ONNX) and per-map terrain line-of-sight rasters, installed out of band under <cache>/decisions.
resourcesDecisionsUnknown: Could not read the pack status.
resourcesDecisionsDemoInUse: The built-in demo model is in use.
resourcesDecisionsRestart: A model already loaded stays in memory until WoWSP restarts.
resourcesDecisionsUnavailable: AI inference is unavailable in this build; the pack is not used.
changelogHint: Release notes are streamed live from the project's GitHub Releases.
feedbackHint: The app keeps a rolling diagnostics log (UTF-8) to attach when reporting issues.
feedbackNoLogs: No log files yet — they appear once the app has logged something.
feedbackHwDesc: The full bundle adds a hardware & environment report of this machine next to the logs. It contains sensitive categories:
feedbackHwItemModels: Model information of the CPU, motherboard, memory, GPUs, sound devices, monitors, disks and network adapters
feedbackHwItemSerial: Hardware identifiers: serial numbers of the disks, memory modules and motherboard, volume serial numbers, the MAC addresses of all network adapters, and GPU device instance IDs (PNPDeviceID)
feedbackHwItemVolumes: Every drive letter with its volume label, file system, capacity and free space
feedbackHwItemEnv: Operating system version, display languages, install date and time since the last boot; VC++ runtimes and DirectX components
feedbackHwItemDriver: GPU driver versions, motherboard BIOS/firmware version, antivirus products and Secure Boot/TPM state
feedbackHwPrivacy: This data can identify your device and is sensitive; it is used only by the author to analyze the reported issue, never for other purposes or shared with third parties. “Export logs only” leaves this hardware report out.
feedbackHwLogsNote: Both options include the logs. On export they are masked: your Windows user name and profile folder, LAN and IPv6 addresses, and search terms and keys in web addresses; account IDs in log fields, API paths and cache file names keep only their last 4 digits. They can still contain game install paths, in-game nicknames, numbers that happen to be account IDs and similar details — check the files before posting them anywhere public.
feedbackHwUac: For the full export Windows will show a User Account Control (UAC) prompt to read administrator-only items (Secure Boot, TPM, some disk serials). Declining it still collects everything readable with normal rights.
feedbackOnlineHint: Send issues and suggestions through the online form: attach screenshots, recordings or the exported log bundle, and track progress under History.
updatesAppHint: The app binary follows the GitHub version tags; an update always downloads the slim installer — the resource pack follows on its own channel.
updatesAppDesc: The program itself (interfaces, replay parsing, overlay).
resPackHint: 3D models and medal art, versioned by content hash on the res-latest release. Incremental chain patches cover the last three versions; older caches fall back to the full download. Versions show as the hash's last 6 characters.
resPackDesc: Ships, maps and aircraft models plus medal artwork (~1.2 GB).
resAfterApp: Update the application first — the resource pack follows after the restart.
resPackMobileHint: This build ships the 3D models and medal art inside the app. Updates download the full pack into app storage and then take precedence; deleting the download falls back to the bundled copy.
resBundledClearNote: Serving the copy bundled in the app. Delete removes a downloaded update only — the bundled pack keeps serving.
uiOpacityHint: One dial for every glass surface: 95% is the default look (the background reads faintly through); lower it to let more show through, raise it to keep panels readable over busy backgrounds.
dataSourceShipDataDesc: Baked ship capability data (radar / hydro / smoke), hot-updatable without an app release.
dataSourceBundled: Not downloaded — bundled data in use
dataSourceModCatalogDesc: The Mod Hub index (expires every 6 hours); installed mods are managed in the Mod Hub.
supportersHint: Everyone who helped the project — click a card to open their Bilibili space.
sponsorHint: Donations are optional — click the card to open the author's afdian page.
sponsorListHint: Synced live from afdian and ordered by current-month then all-time totals; a chip opens the sponsor's afdian profile.
upstreamHint: Open-source projects this app builds on.
resourcesHint: Partner assets used by the app; the rights stay with their authors.
dataSourceModCatalogNone: No catalog yet — refresh to fetch

overlayContent.title: Display content
overlayContent.hint: Choose which numbers the water table shows — on the Tab overlay and the live / post-battle roster panels alike; changes apply immediately everywhere.
overlayContent.battleScopeDesc: Which battle-mode career the numbers come from: follow the current battle (ranked battles show ranked stats, everything else randoms), or pin randoms / ranked / global (randoms + ranked merged).
overlayContent.sealToggleDesc: Press the 神了/猴/蛆 verdict stamps beside the names as plain text — Chinese interface only, and it requires the PR rating master switch.
overlayContent.sealNeedsPr: Turn on the PR rating switch in the stats section first — the seals grade that rating.
overlayContent.avgToggleDesc: Show both teams' mean winrate · mean PR · mean damage under their roster; the higher side renders green, the lower red; tier weighting follows the Stats setting, and the PR item needs the stats section's PR rating switch.
overlayContent.colEmpty: No columns configured — add one via the + button

pairingWip: Phone pairing is under development and not finished yet.
pluginPromptHint: When a launch finds a game but no in-game plugin, a window suggests installing it. Checking "Don't ask again" silences the auto-ask; this re-check is always the way back in.
pluginPromptStateInstalled: The in-game plugin is installed for the active game.
pluginPromptStateAbsent: The in-game plugin is not installed for the active game.
dupCheckDesc: A silent update from an old version could leave a second WoWSP install on the default path. WoWSP checks for such a leftover at launch and offers to remove it.
dupCheckToggle: Check for leftover installs at launch
dupCheckToggleDesc: When a leftover install is found, ask whether to uninstall it. The ask goes quiet only after ticking "don't ask again" in its dialog.
dupNone: No other WoWSP installation was detected.
dupNoUninstaller: That folder has no uninstaller, so automatic removal is unavailable.
dupUninstallDone: The leftover installation has been removed.
dupPromptMsg: A second WoWSP installation was detected at {path}{version}, most likely left behind by an old silent update. Uninstall it? The copy you are using right now is not affected.
dupPromptNever: Don't ask again (re-enable under Settings → Install cleanup)

chatTranslate.title: Chat translation
chatTranslate.enableDesc: Detect foreign-language battle chat and translate it. Turn it on to configure the provider, the target languages and how translations are sent.
chatTranslate.consentBody: Battle chat lines and a little match context (ship names, both teams' situation) are sent to the translation provider you configure below. The provider key is stored in chat-translate.toml on this machine and is sent only to that provider. Nothing is uploaded to WoWSP.
chatTranslate.envOverrideBadge: API key overridden by an environment variable
chatTranslate.providerHint: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works. The API key is stored locally and is never shown again.
chatTranslate.baseUrlDesc: Must include the scheme, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com
chatTranslate.apiKeySet: Configured — enter a new key to replace it
chatTranslate.languagesHint: Auto translates every foreign language detected in the battle; fixed uses only the target languages picked below.
chatTranslate.panelEnableDesc: Show the chat-translation panel at the bottom-left of the overlay while Tab is held.
chatTranslate.tryEmpty: No translatable text came back — try a longer sentence.
chatTranslate.tryNeedKey: Enable chat translation and save an API key first.
chatTranslate.sendModeDesc: Copy each translated line to the clipboard when you send a message, so Ctrl+V pastes it ready-made.
chatTranslate.offHint: Turn chat translation on to configure the provider, target languages and how translations are sent.
chatTranslate.consentItemText: The battle chat lines that need translation.
chatTranslate.consentItemContext: A little match context: ship names and both teams' basic situation.
chatTranslate.consentItemProvider: These go to the translation provider you configure and nowhere else.
chatTranslate.consentItemLocal: The provider key stays in a local settings file on this machine.
chatTranslate.saveFailed: Could not save — check that the app can write its settings, then try again.
